newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: JCI joins Star Russia gold project.
newsitem.headline: JCI joins Star Russia gold project.

text.p: JCI Ltd announced on Wednesday that it had reached an agreement with Star Mining Corp NL to develop the Russian Sukhoi Log gold deposit.

The transaction will entail JCI subscribing for $7.5 million worth of Star shares, providing a guarantee allowing the advance of a $50 million loan to a Star unit and subscribing for shares and loan notes in that unit for an amount of $170 million.
"JCI is pleased to announce that agreement has been reached with Star Mining Corp... for JCI to assist and participate with Star towards the development of Sukhoi Log," the group said.
The deposit is situated in the Central Siberian Highlands and is one of the world's largest undeveloped gold deposits.
JCI's subscription for $7.5 million of Star shares will take place in three tranches. The first would be $3.0 million immediately at an issue price of 18 Australian cents per share.

The second, $2.0 million at an issue price of 80 percent of the market price after the Russian authorities confirm the structure of Sukhoi Log Mining Company (SLMC) or Star shareholders approve the JCI transaction.

The third tranche would be $2.5 million at an issue price of 80 percent of the market value once the above protocol is implemented thereby securing Star Technology Systems Ltd (STS), a wholly-owned unit of Star, 49 percent of SLMC.

JCI will also provide a guarantee for a $50 million loan to STS by Standard Bank London to enable STS to fund its obligation relating to the 49 percent of SLMC. The funds will only be released when the Russian protocol has been implemented.
JCI and Star have also agreed to investigate the feasibility of listing STS on an international stock exchange with a view to enabling STS to repay its $50 million loan.

Subject to the bankability of the project, JCI will subscribe for shares, for a nominal consideration, and preferential loan notes in STS for $170 million which will give JCI a 60 percent equity interest in STS.
